pc.intro.title: What is PhotoCraft ArtCraft?
pc.intro.p1: PhotoCraft is the image editor inside ArtCraft, an open-source creative studio built by the team behind Storyteller.ai. When people search for PhotoCraft ArtCraft, they usually want one thing: a free program that opens their PSD files and behaves like Photoshop, without a monthly bill. That is exactly the gap PhotoCraft is built to close.
pc.intro.p2: The project is a clean-room reimplementation written entirely in Rust. Its developers rebuilt Photoshop's workflows from public specifications and observed behavior rather than Adobe code, which is what lets them release it under permissive open-source licenses. The canvas is drawn on your GPU through wgpu, using Metal on macOS, DirectX 12 on Windows and Vulkan on Linux. There is no Electron shell and no browser engine underneath, so it starts quickly and stays responsive on ordinary laptops.
pc.intro.p3: PhotoCraft ArtCraft concentrates on the parts of Photoshop people use every day: layers and groups, pixel and vector masks, clipping masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, smart objects, live type, pen paths and a full brush engine with pen pressure and tilt. Menus, panels and shortcuts sit where Photoshop users expect them, so the learning curve is measured in minutes, not weeks.
pc.intro.p4: It is honest about its stage. PhotoCraft is still an early alpha, and its own documentation says it is not yet a replacement for daily professional work. New builds land every few days, though, and each release closes visible gaps. If you have been waiting for an open-source Photoshop alternative that feels familiar from the first click, this is the most promising one to try today.
pc.intro.quote: The image editor you already know how to use.
pc.ft.title: Everything you reach for in Photoshop, rebuilt natively
pc.ft.1.title: Familiar from the first click
pc.ft.1.desc: Every Photoshop menu item is wired to a command, and the panels, tools and shortcuts follow the layout your hands already know. Subject selection and Select and Mask run on your own machine.
pc.ft.2.title: Non-destructive by default
pc.ft.2.desc: 16 adjustment layers, more than 70 live-preview filters, smart objects with smart filters and a full set of layer styles.
pc.ft.3.title: Real PSD round-trips
pc.ft.3.desc: Opens and saves layered PSD and PSB. 307 of 309 files in the psd-tools test set re-save with a matching render.
pc.ft.4.title: A GPU canvas, not a web view
pc.ft.4.desc: Composited on Metal, Vulkan, DirectX 12 or WebGPU through wgpu, with a CPU reference renderer behind it.
pc.ft.5.title: Color you can trust
pc.ft.5.desc: 8, 16 and 32-bit documents in RGB, CMYK, Lab and Grayscale, with ICC profiles, soft proofing and gamut warning.
pc.ft.6.title: Scriptable by people and agents
pc.ft.6.desc: More than 500 commands are shared by the UI, a headless CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server.

pc.ac.title: One open-source studio, seven Crafting Apps
pc.ac.p1: ArtCraft began as an open-source studio for controllable AI image and video, with 2D and 3D compositing, character posing and scene blocking for filmmakers and artists. In 2026 the team started rebuilding the classic desktop creative suite in Rust as a family of Crafting Apps. PhotoCraft is the first and most mature of them.
pc.ac.p2: ArtCraft open source means you can read every line of the code, build it yourself and ship modified versions. PhotoCraft is dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0, so commercial use is allowed. The ArtCraft name and logos stay trademarks of the project, which means forks need their own branding.
pc.ac.p3: Every app installs and updates through one ArtCraft Launcher, shares the same command registry and is developed in public on GitHub, where the PhotoCraft repository alone has passed 70,000 stars.

pc.install.title: Install it in about two minutes
pc.install.sub: Pick your system for the exact steps, plus fixes for the warnings you might see on first launch.
pc.install.mac.1: Download the Universal disk image (.dmg). It runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
pc.install.mac.2: Open the .dmg and drag PhotoCraft into your Applications folder.
pc.install.mac.3: Launch it from Applications or Spotlight. If macOS asks about an app downloaded from the internet, click Open.
pc.install.mac.4: Optional: unzip the command-line tool and put photocraft-cli on your PATH for headless batch edits.
pc.install.win.1: Download the 64-bit installer (.msi). Choose ARM64 for Snapdragon laptops or x86 for old 32-bit systems.
pc.install.win.2: Double-click the .msi and follow the installer. PhotoCraft appears in the Start menu.
pc.install.win.3: If SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway. New open-source releases often trigger it.
pc.install.win.4: Prefer no installer? Unzip the portable build anywhere and run photocraft.exe.
pc.install.tip.wayland.title: Drag and drop on Wayland
pc.install.tip.wayland.desc: Not supported yet. Use File, Open, paste from the clipboard, or run under XWayland.
pc.install.tip.gpu.title: Blank or slow canvas
pc.install.tip.gpu.desc: Update your graphics drivers so Metal, Vulkan or DirectX 12 is available to wgpu.
pc.install.tip.verify.title: Verify a download
pc.install.tip.verify.desc: Compare shasum -a 256 (macOS, Linux) or Get-FileHash (Windows) against SHA256SUMS.txt.
pc.install.tip.update.title: Staying current
pc.install.tip.update.desc: Alpha builds ship often. The ArtCraft Launcher updates PhotoCraft for you.

pc.cmp.sub: PhotoCraft copies Photoshop's way of working on purpose, but the two are at very different points in their lives. This is how they compare right now.

pc.rv.title: What it is like to use
pc.rv.sub: A summary of what early testers and reviewers report after real editing sessions with the alpha builds.
pc.rv.1.title: First launch
pc.rv.1.desc: It opens fast and stays responsive, even on a low-power laptop with integrated graphics. No account, no upsell screen, no cloud prompt.
pc.rv.2.title: Instantly familiar
pc.rv.2.desc: Tool placement, menus and shortcuts follow Photoshop more closely than any other look-alike. Most people find their way within minutes.
pc.rv.3.title: PSD round-trips
pc.rv.3.desc: Layered files open with groups, masks, type and styles intact, then save back for colleagues who stay on Photoshop.
pc.rv.4.title: Where the alpha shows
pc.rv.4.desc: It looks closer than it behaves. Some filters render differently from Adobe's, and memory can reach about 5 GB on large PSDs.
pc.rv.pros.1: Free and open source, no subscription or account
pc.rv.pros.2: Photoshop-style interface with almost no relearning
pc.rv.pros.3: Reads and writes layered PSD and PSB
pc.rv.pros.4: Fast GPU rendering on modest hardware
pc.rv.cons.1: Early alpha, so bugs and missing features
pc.rv.cons.2: Complex edits can differ from Photoshop
pc.rv.cons.3: No generative fill and no Photoshop plug-ins
pc.rv.cons.4: High memory use on very large documents
pc.rv.verdict: PhotoCraft is the most convincing free take on the Photoshop experience so far. Hobbyists, students, Linux users and anyone who only needs Photoshop occasionally should install it today. Professionals can treat it as a promising second tool for now.
pc.rv.sources: Sources: the PhotoCraft README and docs, getartcraft.com, and hands-on coverage by OMG! Ubuntu, October 2026.
pc.faq.title: Questions people ask
pc.faq.1.a: Yes. PhotoCraft is released under the MIT or Apache-2.0 license. There is no subscription, trial or account, and you can use it for commercial work.
pc.faq.2.a: Yes. The ArtCraft open source projects, including PhotoCraft and the launcher, are developed in public on GitHub under the storytold organisation. PhotoCraft uses MIT or Apache-2.0. The ArtCraft name and logos are trademarks and are not covered by the code license.
pc.faq.3.q: How are PhotoCraft and ArtCraft related?
pc.faq.3.a: ArtCraft is an open-source studio for controllable AI image and video. PhotoCraft is its image editor and one of the Crafting Apps, alongside VectorCraft, FilmCraft, LightCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft and DesignCraft.
pc.faq.4.q: Can PhotoCraft open Photoshop PSD files?
pc.faq.4.a: Yes. It reads and writes layered PSD and PSB files with groups, masks, type, smart objects and layer styles. Re-saved files are not byte-identical, but nearly all of the project's test files render the same.
pc.faq.5.a: Not yet for professional daily work. The developers call it early alpha. Generative AI, some tools, deeper typography and plug-in support are still missing.
pc.faq.6.q: Which systems does it run on?
pc.faq.6.a: macOS (Universal), Windows 10 and 11 (x64, ARM64, x86), Linux (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V) and FreeBSD 14, plus a WebAssembly build you can host. A GPU with Metal, Vulkan, DirectX 12 or WebGPU is recommended.
pc.faq.7.q: Is it safe to download here?
pc.faq.7.a: Every download button links directly to the official storytold/photocraft releases on GitHub. You can check each file against the published SHA256SUMS.txt.
pc.faq.8.q: Is this the official PhotoCraft website?
pc.faq.8.a: No. This is an independent guide. The official page is getartcraft.com/apps/photocraft and the source is at github.com/storytold/photocraft. We are not affiliated with ArtCraft or Adobe.
pc.faq.9.a: Subject and object selection run on-device. Generative features such as AI fill are not in PhotoCraft yet. ArtCraft's AI image and video tools are a separate app.

pc.page.install.title: How to Install PhotoCraft ArtCraft on Mac, Windows and Linux
pc.page.install.desc: Install PhotoCraft ArtCraft in about two minutes: DMG, MSI, AppImage, deb, rpm, Flatpak or build the ArtCraft open source code with Rust, plus troubleshooting.
pc.page.install.lede: Installing PhotoCraft takes about two minutes on any system. On a Mac you drag one app into Applications. On Windows you run a standard MSI or unzip a portable build. On Linux you can choose an AppImage, a Flatpak or a native deb or rpm package. Because ArtCraft open source code is public, you can also compile PhotoCraft yourself with a recent Rust toolchain. The steps below cover each route and the warnings you may see the first time you open it.
pc.page.compare.title: PhotoCraft vs Photoshop: Features, Price and Verdict
pc.page.compare.desc: PhotoCraft ArtCraft vs Adobe Photoshop: price, PSD support, layers, adjustments, AI, platforms and automation, with a hands-on review of the open-source editor.
pc.page.compare.lede: PhotoCraft ArtCraft was designed to feel like Photoshop, so the obvious question is how close it gets. The short answer: close enough for everyday layered editing and PSD work, not yet close enough to replace a professional Photoshop setup. Below we compare price, licensing, platforms, file support, editing features, AI and automation side by side, then share what it is actually like to use.
vc.page.main.title: VectorCraft: Free Open-Source Illustrator Alternative (Download & Online)
vc.page.main.desc: VectorCraft is the free, open-source vector editor from ArtCraft, written in Rust. Download it for Mac, Windows or Linux, or use VectorCraft online in your browser.
vc.page.main.h1: VectorCraft: the free, open-source Illustrator alternative
vc.page.main.lede: VectorCraft is a vector illustration app from the ArtCraft team, written from scratch in Rust. It has the Pen, Direct Selection, Pathfinder, Layers and Appearance panels you know from Adobe Illustrator, opens SVG, PDF and PDF-compatible .ai files, and can be driven by AI agents over MCP. It is free under the MIT or Apache-2.0 license and runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and in the browser. You can try it online right now, without installing anything.
vc.page.online.title: VectorCraft Online: Free Vector Editor in Your Browser, No Install
vc.page.online.desc: Use VectorCraft online for free: the open-source Illustrator alternative running in your browser through WebAssembly. No sign-up, no install, and your files never leave your computer.
vc.page.online.h1: VectorCraft online: a free vector editor in your browser
vc.page.online.lede: This is the full VectorCraft app compiled to WebAssembly, the same version as the desktop download. Click Launch to start it. There is no account or install, and drawing happens entirely on your own computer.
vc.page.cmp.title: VectorCraft vs Illustrator (2026): Price, Features and Which to Choose
vc.page.cmp.desc: VectorCraft vs Adobe Illustrator compared: price, platforms, .ai and SVG support, drawing tools, AI automation and maturity. Where the free open-source editor wins and where Illustrator still leads.
vc.page.cmp.lede: VectorCraft was built to feel like Illustrator: the same tool names, panels and shortcuts. So how close does it get? It wins clearly on price, openness, platforms and AI automation, and it already covers everyday vector illustration. Illustrator still leads on depth, .ai compatibility, plugins and polish. Here is the side-by-side breakdown, and who should pick which.
vc.about.title: What is VectorCraft?
vc.about.p1: VectorCraft is an open-source vector illustration editor. It is a clean-room reimplementation of the Illustrator workflow, written in pure Rust with no Adobe code or assets, and it renders on the GPU so large documents stay smooth.
vc.about.p2: It is one of the Crafting Apps from the ArtCraft team, alongside PhotoCraft (images), FilmCraft (video) and PdfCraft (PDF). The project started on GitHub in late September 2026 and was called DrawCraft until it was renamed in October 2026. New releases ship every few days.
vc.about.p3: Not to be confused with other products that share the name, such as a Figma plugin for converting bitmaps to SVG or a web tool for animated SVG icons. This page is about the ArtCraft vector editor.

vc.ft.title: The Illustrator tools you already know
vc.ft.sub: Same layout, same tool names, same shortcuts. If you have used Illustrator, you can start drawing in VectorCraft straight away.
vc.ft.1.title: Pen and Direct Selection
vc.ft.1.desc: Real Bézier anchors and handles, Smart Guides and a contextual task bar that offers the next likely action.
vc.ft.2.title: Pathfinder and Shape Builder
vc.ft.2.desc: Exact curve booleans, so no more "cannot perform operation". Plus Gradient Mesh, live radial Repeat and Envelope Distort.
vc.ft.3.title: Live Blends, Layers and Appearance
vc.ft.3.desc: Editable blend paths with smooth colour, every object as a row in Layers, and stacked fills, strokes and effects.
vc.ft.4.title: Perspective Grid
vc.ft.4.desc: Attach art to the grid's planes and it stays editable in perspective, ready for packaging and city scenes.
vc.ft.5.title: 3D Revolve
vc.ft.5.desc: Spin a profile into a 3D object with smooth vector shading, caps and an on-canvas rotation gizmo.
vc.ft.6.title: Dimension tool
vc.ft.6.desc: Lengths, angles and radii that follow the artwork they measure, for technical drawings and product sheets.
vc.fmt.title: Open your files, export what you need
vc.fmt.sub: VectorCraft saves to a documented JSON format and reads and writes the common exchange formats, including Affinity documents that Illustrator can't open.
vc.fmt.note: Illustrator .ai files open when they were saved with PDF compatibility (the default), and legacy version 7 .ai files keep their layers, groups and type. Proprietary Illustrator-only editing data is not written back, and reliable round trips with real-world .ai files are still being worked on.
vc.mcp.title: Built for AI agents from day one
vc.mcp.sub: Every menu item, tool gesture, panel and dialog can be driven over a JSON control channel and a built-in MCP server. Claude and other AI agents can draw, edit and export in VectorCraft the way a person does.
vc.mcp.1.title: Describe it, get vector art
vc.mcp.1.desc: Ask your AI agent for an icon, a poster or a diagram and watch it build real, editable paths instead of a flat image.
vc.mcp.2.title: Automate the boring parts
vc.mcp.2.desc: Batch-export artboards, rename layers, recolour a set of icons or prepare files for print with a single instruction.
vc.mcp.3.title: Readable files
vc.mcp.3.desc: The native .vectorcraft format is plain JSON, so scripts, AI tools and Git can read, diff and generate your artwork.
vc.onl.teaser.title: Use VectorCraft online, right in your browser
vc.onl.teaser.desc: The full app runs in your browser through WebAssembly. Open it, draw, and save your work to your computer. No account, no upload.
vc.dl.title: Download VectorCraft
vc.dl.sub: Choose your platform. Every button links straight to the official VectorCraft release on GitHub, so you always get the original, unmodified build.
vc.dl.signed: The macOS app is signed and notarized by Apple, and the Windows installers are code-signed, so they open without security warnings.
vc.install.title: Installing in one minute

vc.status.sub: VectorCraft is alpha software that is moving fast. Here is an honest picture of what works and what is still missing.

vc.faq.title: VectorCraft FAQ
vc.faq.1.a: Yes. VectorCraft is open source under your choice of the MIT or Apache-2.0 license. There is no subscription, trial or account, and you can use it for commercial work.
vc.faq.2.q: Can VectorCraft open Adobe Illustrator .ai files?
vc.faq.2.a: Partly. It opens .ai files saved with PDF compatibility (Illustrator's default) and legacy version 7 .ai files with their layers, groups and type, and it can export PDF-compatible .ai. Illustrator-only editing data is not written, and reliable round trips with complex real-world .ai files are still in progress, so keep your originals.
vc.faq.3.q: Can I use VectorCraft online without installing it?
vc.faq.3.a: Yes. The web version runs in any modern desktop browser through WebAssembly. Open VectorCraft online on this site, click Launch and start drawing. Your files stay on your own computer.
vc.faq.4.q: Which systems does VectorCraft run on?
vc.faq.4.a: macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows (x64, ARM64 and 32-bit), Linux (x86_64 and ARM64 as AppImage, Flatpak, deb, rpm or tarball), FreeBSD 14 and the web.
vc.faq.5.q: Is VectorCraft the same as DrawCraft?
vc.faq.5.a: Yes. The project was called DrawCraft when it launched and was renamed VectorCraft in October 2026. It is the same ArtCraft vector editor.
vc.faq.6.q: Is this the VectorCraft Figma plugin?
vc.faq.6.a: No. A few unrelated products use the same name, including a Figma plugin that converts bitmaps to SVG. This page covers the open-source vector editor from the ArtCraft team.
vc.faq.7.a: Inkscape is mature, stable and built around SVG. VectorCraft is much younger but copies Illustrator's layout, tools and shortcuts, renders faster on the GPU and can be controlled by AI agents. If you are coming from Illustrator, VectorCraft will feel more familiar. If you need proven stability today, Inkscape is the safer choice.
vc.faq.8.q: Does VectorCraft have a Chinese interface?
vc.faq.8.a: Yes. The interface is available in 21 languages, including Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean. In the current web version, Chinese and Korean menus are missing some characters because of a known upstream font bug, so VectorCraft online starts in English for those browsers; the desktop apps are not affected.
vc.faq.9.q: Is this the official VectorCraft website?
vc.faq.9.a: No. This is an independent guide. The official page is getartcraft.com/apps/vectorcraft, and every download here links to the official GitHub releases.

vc.adv.title: Where VectorCraft beats Illustrator
vc.adv.sub: Six areas where the free, open-source newcomer already has the edge.
vc.adv.1.title: Free, with no subscription
vc.adv.1.desc: Illustrator costs from US$22.99 a month on an annual plan, with a fee if you cancel early. VectorCraft is free forever, including for commercial work.
vc.adv.2.title: Runs everywhere, even in a browser
vc.adv.2.desc: Native builds for macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, plus a full web version. Illustrator has no Linux version at all.
vc.adv.3.title: AI agents can use it
vc.adv.3.desc: A built-in MCP server lets Claude and other agents draw, edit and export real vector paths. Illustrator has no equivalent agent interface.
vc.adv.4.title: Open, readable files
vc.adv.4.desc: The native format is documented JSON that works with Git and scripts, instead of a proprietary .ai file only one company controls.
vc.adv.5.title: Opens Affinity documents
vc.adv.5.desc: Moving from Affinity Designer? VectorCraft opens .af, .afdesign and .afpub files with layers, artboards and text. Illustrator can't.
vc.adv.6.title: Fast and robust
vc.adv.6.desc: Multithreaded GPU rendering draws 20,000 shapes in about 27 ms, and exact curve booleans mean Pathfinder doesn't fail on tricky paths.

vc.onl.how.title: How VectorCraft online works
vc.onl.how.sub: It is the real desktop app, compiled to WebAssembly. Here is what that means for you.
vc.onl.how.1.title: Runs on your computer
vc.onl.how.1.desc: Everything happens inside your browser. Your drawings are never uploaded to a server.
vc.onl.how.2.title: Open and save like a desktop app
vc.onl.how.2.desc: Open SVG, PDF or .ai files from your disk, and Save or Export downloads the file back to your computer.
vc.onl.how.3.title: GPU accelerated
vc.onl.how.3.desc: It uses WebGPU when your browser has it and falls back to WebGL2 automatically. Recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari all work.
vc.onl.how.4.title: Same version as the download
vc.onl.how.4.desc: The online version is updated with each official release. For AI-agent control over MCP and for the command-line tool, use the desktop builds.
vc.onl.faq.1.a: Yes. It is free and open source, with no sign-up, no watermark and no limits on what you can export.
vc.onl.faq.2.a: No. The app runs locally in your browser. Files you open are read from your disk, and saving downloads them back to your computer.
vc.onl.faq.3.q: The app shows a blank or black screen. What can I do?
vc.onl.faq.3.a: Some graphics drivers have trouble with WebGPU. Use the compatibility mode link under the app, which forces WebGL2. Make sure your browser is up to date, and try Chrome or Edge if the problem continues.
vc.onl.faq.4.q: What is the difference between VectorCraft online and the desktop app?
vc.onl.faq.4.a: The drawing features are the same. The desktop app starts faster, handles large files better, works fully offline and includes the MCP server for AI agents and the command-line tool.
vc.onl.faq.5.q: Does VectorCraft online work on a phone or iPad?
vc.onl.faq.5.a: It can load on recent tablets, but the interface is designed for a mouse or trackpad and keyboard. For real work, use a desktop or laptop browser.
vc.onl.faq.6.q: Why does VectorCraft online open in English when my browser is set to Chinese?
vc.onl.faq.6.a: The current web build has a known font bug (VectorCraft issue #2689): it ships only Japanese fonts for its menus, so many Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean characters show as empty boxes. Until the ArtCraft team fixes it, we start the online version in English for Chinese and Korean browsers. You can still choose Chinese under Preferences, and the desktop apps display Chinese correctly with your system fonts.
